run_flash_attention_forward: run the flash attention forward pass with query, key, value states, attention mask, and optional position ids
lazy_import_flash_attention: lazy import flash attention and return the respective functions plus flags for a given implementation version
process_flash_attention_kwargs: process flash attention kwargs and return a filtered dict of supported parameters based on the loaded implementation
check_flash_attn_availability: check whether any flash attention implementation is available in the current environment
unpad_and_pad_attention_inputs: unpad query, key, value tensors based on attention mask and pad the flash attention output back to batched shape
